title: Fire Resistance (Condition)
html:
Fire Resistance

  • You gain Resistance to ⁠Fire damage, and can no longer  Burn.

Properties

UID: POTION_OF_RESISTANCE_FIRE

 Stack ID: ALCH_ELIXIR

Sources of Fire Resistance

  • Elixir of Fire Resistance

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID ALCH_ELIXIR, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Acid Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Acid damage.
Cold Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Cold damage.
Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
  • Has an additional  Level 1 Spell Slot. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Elixir of Barkskin
  •  Armour Class increased to 16.
Elixir of Battlemage's Power
  • Affected entity has  Arcane Acuity until its next Long Rest. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
    • Gain Arcane Acuity for 3 turns.
    • Arcane Acuity cannot go below 3 turns.
Elixir of Bloodlust
  • Affected entity has entered a murderous state of bloodlust. Once per turn, when it kills an enemy, it gains  5 temporary hit points and an  Action. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Elixir of Cloud Giant Strength
  • Strength increased to 27.
Elixir of Darkvision
  • Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).
Elixir of Guileful Movement
  • Movement Speed cannot be reduced by Difficult Terrain, spells, or magical effects.
  • Can't be  Paralysed or  Restrained.
  • Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Elixir of Heroism
  • Affected entity is granted a 1d4 bonus to  Attack Rolls and  Saving Throws until the next long rest.
Elixir of Hill Giant Strength
  • Strength increased to 21.
Elixir of Peerless Focus
  • Affected entity's ability to maintain its spells has increased.
  • It has  Advantage to  Saving Throws against being  Charmed and for maintaining  Concentration.
  • Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
  • Can't be put to  Sleep.
Elixir of The Colossus
  • Size is increased
  • Weapons deal an additional 1d4 damage, and the affected entity has  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving Throws.
  • Carrying capacity is also increased by 25%.
Elixir of Viciousness
  • The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Elixir of Vigilance
  • Affected entity has a +5 bonus to initiative and can't be  Surprised. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Fire Resistance
  • You gain Resistance to ⁠Fire damage, and can no longer  Burn.
Force Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Force damage.
Greater Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
  • Has an additional  Level 2 Spell Slot. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Lightning Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Lightning damage. Can no longer be  Shocked,  Electrocuted,  Jolted, or otherwise affected by lightning.
Necrotic Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Necrotic damage.
Poison Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Poison damage. Can no longer be  Poisoned.
Psionic Weakening
  • Affected entity has  Disadvantage on Constitution, Wisdom and Intelligence  Saving Throws. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Psychic Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Psychic damage.
Radiant Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Radiant damage.
Resistant to Acid Damage
  • Acid damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Fire Damage
  • Fire damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Lightning Damage
  • Lightning damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Necrotic Damage
  • Necrotic damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Radiant Damage
  • Radiant damage against this entity is halved.
Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
  • Has an additional  Level 3 Spell Slot. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Supreme Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
  • Has an additional  Level 4 Spell Slot. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Thunder Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Thunder damage.
